description.value:
You channel the brutal cold of the Grey Waste into a creature you touch, flash-freezing its body from the outside in.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes 5d8 cold damage.

Failure The creature takes 3d8 cold damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Restrained]{Restrained} (Escape DC equals your spell DC) as ice encases its limbs. At the start of each of the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Restrained]{Restrained} creature's turns, it takes 3d8 cold damage. The creature can attempt a Fortitude save at the end of each of its turns to end the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Restrained]{Restrained} condition; on a success, the ice shatters.

Critical Failure The creature takes 6d8 cold damage and is immediately @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Petrified]{Petrified} (as the condition) as it becomes a statue of ice. The @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Petrified]{Petrified} creature continues to make Fortitude saves at the end of each of its turns; three consecutive successes end the condition. If the spell is sustained for the full minute while the creature remains @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Petrified]{Petrified}, the ice becomes permanent until the ambient temperature rises above freezing for a sustained period.

Heightened (+1) The initial damage on failure increases by 1d8 and the per-turn cold damage while @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Restrained]{Restrained} increases by 1d8.
